## Design system checklist

- [ ] No new hardcoded colors, shadows, or spacing — used `var(--token)` from `colors_and_type.css` / `shadcn/theme.css`
- [ ] Shadows are offset-only (no blur), per the paper-sticker aesthetic
- [ ] New or changed components are reflected in `/preview` and listed in `PREVIEWS.md`
- [ ] Checked against the voice/content guidelines in `README.md` (sentence case, no emoji in UI, etc.)
- [ ] Considered accessibility (contrast, labels, focus states)
